title: Instructors can preview, select and add single tracks from Music playlists and Songs
acceptance: Playlist detail rows offer preview and select, reusing the builder TrackPreview path, with an "Add selected" or "Start class from selected" action (D21). As on Music › Songs, a row tap selects and never starts playback; preview is a separate control. Music › Songs preview is the child RF-172; RF-151 owns Songs selection and its Create a class action.
The playlist header shows a track count when the provider reports one, and the 15-song import limit is stated before Start class.
Preview plays only through the official provider SDK or widget; nothing is cached.
Keyboard and screen-reader access match the existing builder preview.
nextAction: Owner, 2026-10-31: preview is a secondary control and never the row tap; rows select. Songs ▶ preview is the child RF-172, which waits on RF-151; this playlist-detail work does not. Design pass first for playlist detail: what selection adds to (new class or an open class). Files: apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx (playlist dialog), TrackPreview.tsx, PlaylistSongPicker.tsx. Check scripts/owner-gate.mjs for the files the PR actually touches; playback code under apps/web/src/lib/playback/ is gated. Either way the PR needs a real-browser preview check, which CI cannot prove. Surface: web.
